score_meaning.reply:
The **score** in Logan results represents **k-mer coverage** -- the fraction of 31-mers from your query sequence (`Plasmodium_falciparum_18S`) that were found in a given run. A score of **1.000** means every 31-mer in your query was detected in that run; a score of **0.62** would mean ~62% of your query's k-mers matched.

For the **227 saturated samples** in this search, the score is adjusted by subtracting a false-positive baseline (reported as `fp_correction`). The `ani` value (when shown) is a Mash Screen ANI estimate derived from `score ** (1/31)`.
